subject.title: feat(usage): show quota for every configured auth profile [AI-assisted]

question: Should explicit usage views query every eligible configured authentication profile by default, accepting bounded additional provider calls and per-profile failure output?
rationale: The patch is technically scoped and proof-backed, but choosing default query breadth for user-facing CLI and Gateway usage views is product and operational policy rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Accept complete profile visibility
options.body: Keep the proposed default for explicit usage views, with bounded concurrency and isolated failures, so multi-account users receive a complete grouped quota report.

options.title: Require opt-in profile reads
options.body: Preserve current provider-level reads by default and add a separately designed explicit mode before querying every configured profile.

recommendation.title: Accept complete profile visibility
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed default for explicit usage views, with bounded concurrency and isolated failures, so multi-account users receive a complete grouped quota report.

likelyOwner.reason: The preserved exact-profile implementation commits provide the clearest available ownership trail for the read-policy tradeoff.
